slices.name: New boards: Workable job search + Jobgether
slices.notes:
SLICE 24 - New boards (added 2026-11-11 IST): Workable's cross-company job search (jobs.workable.com JSON API, remote + India) and Jobgether 'Remote from India' role pages. Own Ember jobs call with `sources` below.
KNOWN PARSER LIMITS (do not treat as facts): rows come back with remote:'Onsite' or 'Unknown', empty company/location, and Jobgether puts the age ('7 days ago') in the location field. Ignore the remote/location fields from these sources; every listing page is already filtered to remote-India.
MANDATORY VERIFY: you MUST Ember-scrape every candidate that passes the title include/exclude words (cap 15 per run, newest first; Jobgether rows saying '30+ days ago' are stale -> skip without scraping). maxTokens 1500, render:true on 403. Company = text after '-at-' at the end of the Workable url, or from the page; Jobgether real company is on the offer page. Apply the hard rejects strictly: keep only Remote from India/Asia/Anywhere, min experience 0-2 yrs, posted within 14 days. A run that matched candidates but scraped none is NOT done: set status 'crashed' with detail 'skipped verify'. url saved = the Workable /view/ url or the Jobgether /offer/ url.

slices.name: Recently funded startups
slices.notes: SLICE 16 - Recently funded startups . Call Ember jobs with `sources` below (own call, never reuse another slice's results). Verified boards for Swastik's startup list (2026-10-13). New startups: take company slugs only from YC job pages (slice 12) or funding news Swastik pastes - never guess.

slices.name: Trading houses & energy majors
slices.notes: SLICE 18 - Trading houses & energy majors . Call Ember jobs with `sources` below (own call). For html/url/workday sources omit locations/excludeLocations/postedWithinDays and judge from each JD. India centres (Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Gurugram, Chennai) are office roles: keep only as HIGHPAY (>= Rs 95k/month in hand; benchmark via AmbitionBox if unstated - if no benchmark, PARK with flag 'pay unknown', do not drop). Abroad = ABROAD. Never trading-desk/trader roles. Avoid Wilmar (culture).

slices.name: Indian boards via Wellfound India

Naukri/Instahyre/Cutshort/Hirist/Foundit are JS-only or blocked for Ember - do not try them. html/url sources carry no reliable location/remote/date: call them WITHOUT locations/excludeLocations/postedWithinDays (keep include/exclude), then decide remote-India + freshness from each JD (scrape). Wellfound JD pages: scrape; if unreadable keep CHECK. Many are on-site: keep only fully remote, or on-site with stated pay >= Rs 95k/month in hand.

slices.name: SLICE 21
slices.notes:
SLICE 21 
Visa-sponsoring and relocation boards (ABROAD list): Relocate.me (relocate.me/search - jobs with relocation packages), Arbeitnow (arbeitnow.com/?visa_sponsorship=true, Germany/EU), MyCareersFuture Singapore (shows salary; non-sales analyst/ops roles, check Employment Pass mention), Bayt, GulfTalent and Naukrigulf (UAE/Gulf: analyst, operations, trade support, commodity, CTRM - keep only if employment visa/sponsorship is stated), UK 'Skilled Worker' sponsor jobs via firecrawl_search 'visa sponsorship analyst graduate UK commodity OR fintech'. Keep roles <=3 yrs, no sales; ABROAD needs a quoted visa/relocation sentence.
